gen-gf-phudu-gf-zalando-sans-expanded: Chunky, stout-limbed and a bit cheeky, with curves that open wide at every tip. But Phudu grabs attention with stout diagonals, while Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its sans-serif letters out with wide gaps.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-zalando-sans-semiexpande: Phudu looks like bent wire shaped into a sign. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded follows with open-mouthed curves, modern and unfussy, letting that bold lettering stand out while the text stays easygoing.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-zcool-xiaowei: ZCOOL XiaoWei reads gently, its strokes swelling mildly from stem to serif without any ink pooling at the turns. But Phudu stands out for one steady line outlining every counter, a firm foil to that mellow range.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Reading here is smooth, with open-mouthed curves and no hairlines or swells to snag on. Zen Kaku Gothic New handles the quiet, approachable text work, while Phudu is the one built to be bold and noticed.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-zen-maru-gothic: Loud, chunky and unmistakably pen-drawn, with every curve ending in a generous opening. But Phudu is best at making a statement, whereas Zen Maru Gothic is best at a smooth read that never snags on a closed bowl.
gen-gf-phudu-ibm-plex-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Phudu draws every stroke at a single width, with generous openings on each curve. IBM Plex Sans is the technical, approachable one, with wide channels into bowls.
gen-gf-phudu-zilla-slab: Phudu looks drawn with a single pen tip, every curve ending in a generous opening and every diagonal stout. Zilla Slab adds a sturdy, technical slab-serif footing beneath it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-clash-grotesk: Clash Grotesk keeps every line uniform, approachable and modulation-free. Beside it, Pixelify Sans turns expressive and loud, its unvarying strokes and paperclip-open c making both uniform in line but different in voice.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-alpino: Alpino is cozy and casual, its tall lowercase making the ascenders look short against Pixelify Sans. And across many lines its tight spacing and well-parted curve endings would read snug yet distinct.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-fs-hind: Hind is a steady, professional sans whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals and whose c never turns its ends inward. Pixelify Sans adds the expressive shout above it, with that open c.
